name: Canada’s Wonderland
description: Seasonal direct GO buses from York Mills and Yorkdale to Canada’s Wonderland. This was the renumbered successor to route 43; later Wonderland service using other route families is a separate service.

timeline.event: The seasonal Wonderland service returned under number 60, replacing number 43.
Weekend/holiday service resumed May 2; daily operation followed May 20.
The original seasonal timetable shows 60 from York Mills via Yorkdale and 60A starting at Yorkdale.
The 2019 service-change account states that route 60 would not return and directs riders to YRT route 20.

gaps: The exact final operating day of the last season has not been established. Route 43 has its own folder for the earlier number.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.
